uncited: SimpleRenderer is a CPU-based renderer for 3D Gaussian Splatting that projects 3D Gaussian distributions into 2D screen-space elliptical splats and composites them using a standard painter's algorithm with alpha blending.

It performs all projection, sorting, and rasterization on the CPU using standard array operations, making it suitable for debugging, thumbnail generation, or environments lacking specialized graphics hardware.
